activeKey.zh-CN: 当前激活的标签页的 itemKey，受控。传 null 时不激活任何标签页，仍是受控；不传或为 undefined 时按非受控处理。
activeKey.en-US: The itemKey of the active tab, controlled. null activates no tab and is still controlled; omitted or undefined means uncontrolled.

arrowPosition.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，左右切换箭头的位置。
arrowPosition.en-US: Position of the scroll arrows in collapsible mode.

children.zh-CN: TabPane 子元素，必须是 Tabs 的直接子元素；其余节点按原顺序作为内容渲染。传了 tabList 时，TabPane 被忽略，其余节点是当前标签页的内容。
children.en-US: TabPane children, which must be direct children of Tabs; any other node renders as content in its original order. With tabList, TabPane children are ignored and the other nodes are the content of the active tab.

collapsible.zh-CN: 是否开启滚动折叠（仅水平模式）。传 'auto' 时在标签溢出或换行时自动折叠，放得下时自动退出。
collapsible.en-US: Whether to collapse overflowing tabs into a scrollable bar (horizontal mode only). 'auto' collapses when the tabs overflow or wrap and leaves the collapse once they fit.

contentStyle.zh-CN: 内容区域外层的样式，可传对象或字符串。
contentStyle.en-US: Style of the outer content area, an object or a string.

defaultActiveKey.zh-CN: 非受控时初始选中的 itemKey。不传时取第一个启用且有 itemKey 的标签页。
defaultActiveKey.en-US: The itemKey selected initially when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first enabled tab that has an itemKey.

dropdownProps.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，分别透传给起始侧（start）与末尾侧（end）箭头下拉菜单的 Dropdown 属性。
dropdownProps.en-US: In collapsible mode, the Dropdown props passed to the start-side (start) and end-side (end) arrow menus.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 使用 TabPane 子元素时，是否渲染未激活面板的 DOM。为 false 时只渲染当前面板，没有切换动画。
keepDOM.en-US: With TabPane children, whether to render the DOM of inactive panels. When false only the active panel is rendered, without motion.

lazyRender.zh-CN: 懒渲染，面板被激活过才渲染内容，之后保留。
lazyRender.en-US: Lazy rendering: a panel renders its content only after it has been active, and keeps it afterwards.

more.zh-CN: 将末尾的一部分标签页收入「更多」下拉菜单。传数字表示收入菜单的标签数；传对象时 count 为标签数，render 返回自定义的触发器，dropdownProps 透传给下拉菜单。
more.en-US: Moves the last tabs into a More dropdown. A number is the count of tabs moved; in an object, count is that number, render returns a custom trigger and dropdownProps is passed to the dropdown.

onChange.zh-CN: 切换标签页时触发，参数为新激活的 itemKey。
onChange.en-US: Called when the active tab changes, with the itemKey of the new active tab.

onTabClick.zh-CN: 单击，或用 Enter、Space 激活标签页时触发；用键盘激活时事件是 KeyboardEvent。
onTabClick.en-US: Called when a tab is clicked or activated with Enter or Space; the event is a KeyboardEvent for keyboard activation.

onTabClose.zh-CN: 关闭标签页时触发，参数为被关闭标签页的 itemKey。标签页的移除由使用方完成。
onTabClose.en-US: Called when a tab is closed, with the itemKey of the closed tab. The caller removes the tab.

onVisibleTabsChange.zh-CN: 折叠模式下溢出项的可见状态变化时触发，参数为 itemKey 到是否可见的 Map。
onVisibleTabsChange.en-US: In collapsible mode, called when the visibility of the tabs changes, with a Map from itemKey to whether it is visible.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内部调用 focus 时，是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focus calls inside the component stop the browser from scrolling the document to the newly focused element.

renderArrow.zh-CN: 替换折叠模式下的每个滚动箭头。参数依次为被滚出的 items、位置 pos、点击处理函数 handleArrowClick 与创建默认箭头的函数 defaultNode，在插入处调用 defaultNode()。items 是普通数据；TabPane 写法下不带 tab，需要标签文本时用 tabList。
renderArrow.en-US: Replaces each scroll arrow in collapsible mode. The arguments are the scrolled-out items, the position pos, the click handler handleArrowClick and defaultNode, which creates the default arrow: call defaultNode() where it is inserted. items are plain data; with TabPane children they have no tab, so use tabList when you need the tab text.

renderIcon.zh-CN: tabList 每一项的图标，参数为该项与其下标。在页签、菜单项等每个插入处各调用一次，该项数据或下标变化时重新调用。
renderIcon.en-US: The icon of each tabList item, called with the item and its index. It is called once at each place the tab shows (the tab, a menu item) and again when the item's data or index changes.

renderTab.zh-CN: tabList 每一项的标签内容，参数为该项与其下标；不传时显示该项的 tab。在页签、菜单项与面板名称等每个插入处各调用一次，该项数据或下标变化时重新调用。
renderTab.en-US: The content of each tabList tab, called with the item and its index; without it the item's tab shows. It is called once at each place the tab shows (the tab, a menu item, the panel's name) and again when the item's data or index changes.

renderTabBar.zh-CN: 替换整个标签栏，同一个函数只调用一次。tabBarProps 是活的标签栏属性，在返回的 JSX 中读取；DefaultTabBar 是默认标签栏组件。
renderTabBar.en-US: Replaces the whole tab bar; the same function is called once. tabBarProps is live, so read its fields inside the returned JSX; DefaultTabBar is the default tab bar component.

showRestInDropdown.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，是否将被收起的标签页展示在下拉菜单中。
showRestInDropdown.en-US: In collapsible mode, whether the collapsed tabs are listed in a dropdown menu.

size.zh-CN: 标签栏尺寸，目前仅线条式（line）标签栏支持。
size.en-US: Size of the tab bar; currently only the line type supports it.

tabBarClassName.en-US: Class name of the tab bar.

tabBarExtraContent.zh-CN: 标签栏的附加内容，位于 tablist 之外。
tabBarExtraContent.en-US: Extra content of the tab bar, placed outside the tablist.

tabBarStyle.zh-CN: 标签栏的样式，可传对象或字符串。
tabBarStyle.en-US: Style of the tab bar, an object or a string.

tabList.zh-CN: 标签页的数据数组，每项只含数据：itemKey、tab（文字）、disabled、closable，节点内容交给 renderTab、renderIcon。只要传了数组（含空数组），children 就是当前标签页的内容，并优先于 TabPane 子元素。
tabList.en-US: An array of tab data. Each item holds data only (itemKey, the tab text, disabled and closable); markup goes to renderTab and renderIcon. Any array, even an empty one, makes children the content of the active tab and takes precedence over TabPane children.

tabPaneMotion.zh-CN: 是否使用动画切换面板。

tabPosition.zh-CN: 标签栏位置：top 为水平，left 为垂直。
tabPosition.en-US: Position of the tab bar: top is horizontal, left is vertical.

type.zh-CN: 标签栏样式：line、card、button、slash。slash 仅支持水平模式。
type.en-US: Style of the tab bar: line, card, button or slash. slash supports horizontal mode only.

visibleTabsStyle.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，整体滚动区域的样式，可传对象或字符串。
visibleTabsStyle.en-US: In collapsible mode, the style of the whole scrolling area, an object or a string.

aria-label.zh-CN: 标签栏的可访问名称，落在 `role="tablist"` 元素上。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the tab bar, placed on the `role="tablist"` element.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 指向标签栏名称元素的 id，落在 `role="tablist"` 元素上。
aria-labelledby.en-US: The id of the element that names the tab bar, placed on the `role="tablist"` element.

closable.zh-CN: 是否允许关闭该标签页，关闭时触发 Tabs 的 onTabClose。
closable.en-US: Whether the tab can be closed; closing calls onTabClose of the Tabs.

icon.zh-CN: 标签栏中该标签的图标，由 Tabs 渲染。
icon.en-US: The icon of the tab in the bar, rendered by the Tabs.

itemKey.zh-CN: 标签页的唯一标识，对应 activeKey。
itemKey.en-US: Unique key of the tab, matched against activeKey.

tab.zh-CN: 标签栏中的标签内容，由 Tabs 渲染。
tab.en-US: The tab content in the bar, rendered by the Tabs.

closable.en-US: Whether to show the close button.

deleteTabItem.zh-CN: 点击关闭按钮时的处理函数，参数为 itemKey 与事件。在 Tabs 内默认由 Tabs 处理，触发 onTabClose。
deleteTabItem.en-US: Handler for the close button, with the itemKey and the event. Inside a Tabs it defaults to the Tabs' own, which calls onTabClose.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用；禁用时点击与关闭按钮不生效，关闭按钮仍会显示。
disabled.en-US: Whether the tab is disabled; clicks and the close button have no effect, while the close button still shows.

handleKeyDown.zh-CN: 键盘处理函数，参数为事件、itemKey 与 closable。在 Tabs 内默认由 Tabs 处理方向键、Home、End、Enter、Space 与 Delete。
handleKeyDown.en-US: Keyboard handler, with the event, the itemKey and closable. Inside a Tabs it defaults to the Tabs' own, which handles the arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Space and Delete.

icon.zh-CN: 标签图标；没有内容则不渲染图标。
icon.en-US: Tab icon; without content no icon is rendered.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击标签时触发，参数为 itemKey 与事件；禁用时不触发。TabItem 本身不会选中标签页，需在回调中更新 Tabs 的 activeKey。
onClick.en-US: Called when the tab is clicked, with the itemKey and the event; not called while disabled. TabItem does not select the tab itself: update the activeKey of the Tabs in the callback.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，small 与 medium 带对应的类名。
size.en-US: Size; small and medium add the matching class name.

tabPosition.zh-CN: 位置，默认取所在 Tabs 的 tabPosition。
tabPosition.en-US: Position; defaults to the tabPosition of the enclosing Tabs.

type.zh-CN: 样式，默认取所在 Tabs 的 type。
type.en-US: Style; defaults to the type of the enclosing Tabs.
